scope: Source-only review of git-show branch contents, no model fitting, experiments, scoring, checkout or branch mutation. No overall verdict.

avy.algorithm: Baseline/transition only; handouts contain no implementation

avyukth/entry-final.algorithm: Full-distribution 50/50 signed-L1 E6 and artifact E7; broad exception falls back E6

avyukth/entry-main.algorithm: E6 signed degree2 L1 C=.5 half_life16; stale docstring says episode memory

avyukth/exp-combo-e2-memory.algorithm: Independent ET and LR soft memory; None/16/32/64; inverse temp128; last24 valid rows stride4; selection trees8/full final trees

avyukth/exp-combo-trees-blend.algorithm: MRO ET/logistic probability mix plus short-history shrinkage; logistic fraction=mix

avyukth/exp-e1-pair-logistic.algorithm: Exact tick lags1..8, binary mains/all pairs, C3 half_life32, pooled_recent positive shape

avyukth/exp-e2-adaptive-memory.algorithm: Joint per-machine half-life/C selection; None/16/32/64 C1/3; hard/soft; last32 valid rows stride4; prequential Brier or logloss

avyukth/exp-e3-pair-selection.algorithm: TRAIN chronological tail holdout ranks each pair versus mains; top5 default; optional full pairs for long histories

avyukth/exp-e4-episode-memory.algorithm: Episode pooled prequential per-row Brier picks None/64/32/16; last24 observed ticks stride3; hard/soft selection

avyukth/exp-e4-shared-change.algorithm: Episode tick split with machine-specific Bernoulli rates; likelihood gain minus BIC and scan penalty; min_side16 step4 threshold5; before_weight=.1

avyukth/exp-e5-shape-head.algorithm: Separate positive-payout context prior and recency counts; optional >=2 lagged WIN-head indicators; no severity regression

avyukth/exp-e6-interactions.algorithm: Signed/binary contiguous configurable lags and degree1/2/3 products; L1 liblinear or L2; pooled_recent shape

avyukth/exp-e7-neural-context.algorithm: TRAIN-only 64 hidden unit hypernetwork maps all-history/recent causal prefix means/correlations/count masses to signed main/pair coefficients; episode holdout; artifact save/load

avyukth/exp-e8-neighbor-inputs.algorithm: Other-machine earlier mean-win lags or individual lag1; missing=.5; same episode only

avyukth/exp-e9-win-blend.algorithm: Temperature and alpha win shrinkage; short_alpha if <100 observed spins; default C10 shape_strength50

avyukth/exp-e10-machine-trees.algorithm: Per-machine ExtraTrees/RF on raw win lags, optional logistic mixture

avyukth/exp-e11-flex-experts.algorithm: Episode memory plus LR/ET/HGB weighted experts; optional missing-lag .5 and logit calibration; latest sweeps HGB weight, ET/HGB leaf sizes, memory and C

reuse_hooks.adaptive: AdaptiveMemorySelector.predict_win(X,y,ticks,xq,cutoff,prior_win=train_prior) returns probability and mean_loss, selected_weights, prequential_ticks/predictions, final_sample_weights, eligible_rows, fallback. Requires causal feature rows and sorted actual ticks.
reuse_hooks.combo: ComboAdaptiveMemoryForecaster.selection_diagnostics gives independent tree/logistic mean_brier_loss, selected_weights, prequential_ticks/predictions and final_probabilities after predict. Requires repeated tree fitting.
reuse_hooks.episode: EpisodeMemoryForecaster._episode_losses(seqs,cutoff) returns pooled candidate Brier; no fit needed for this helper. Scorer C/min_rows configurable; lags are not forwarded.
reuse_hooks.uncertainty: Derive ESS=(sum(w)^2)/sum(w*w) from adaptive final weights, candidate selection entropy, win disagreement and prequential support. None is supplied as calibrated uncertainty.
reuse_hooks.volatility: Derive short-memory minus long-memory causal Brier regret on matched evaluation ticks; aggregate squared residual mean/variance and episode agreement. These existing selector regrets describe their binary LR/tree heads, not the parent parity mixer.
reuse_hooks.sign_flip: SharedChange detects marginal Bernoulli rate shifts; directions are rate directions. Balanced parity-coefficient sign flips require conditional parity-feature/target correlations or residual likelihood split, not this marginal scan.
reuse_hooks.severity: E5 has unconditional positive counts/prior and optional >=2 lags in WIN head. No explicit severity-lag1/2/4 mode exists; use parent severity model to derive separate change features.

invocation.predict_only: Isolate git-show package outside shared sources. tq,th=load_inputs(train_path); labels=read_labels(train_path/labels.csv,tq); vq,vh=load_inputs(validation_path); m=Class(**frozen_settings).fit(tq,th,labels); pred=m.predict(vq,vh). Avoid experiment runners: they additionally score audit/test.
invocation.neural: Use cached TM_E7/TM_E67; alternatively NeuralContextForecaster.load_artifact(path).predict(vq,vh). Final artifact exists at origin/avyukth/entry-final:mainFiles/entry/models/state.pt. Do not call neural fit now.
invocation.strict_cutoffs: Use tick-keyed exact lag lookups. index_history rejects any observed tick>=machine cutoff. For gate backtests trim ALL same-episode machine streams to tick<t before predicting outcome t. Fit pooled priors on TRAIN only, never validation labels/history.
invocation.episode_grouping: Invoke episode memory separately per episode/cutoff; implementation groups only episode and uses first query cutoff. Shared-change correctly groups episode/cutoff.

caveats.fact: Selection always instantiates default eight-lag all-pair binary LR; outer lags/pairs, E11 imputation and expert mix are not forwarded. LR proxy may not match final estimator.
Episode grouping uses first cutoff; different-machine cutoffs need external grouping. Pooling weights each scored row equally rather than each machine.
Infinite candidate losses replaced by worst finite loss in soft mode, giving unsupported candidates positive weight. All-inf hard fallback chooses first None memory.
Too-short/one-class fallback ignores recency: unweighted y plus two prior pseudo-observations. Default prior_win=.4 unless supplied or learned TRAIN global prior.
Diagnostic key includes entire supplied seq, even hypothetical postcutoff items; fitting itself filters tick<cutoff. Ordinary predict uses schema guard.
Shape context priors count TRAIN histories plus supplied terminal TRAIN labels; fitting on validation inputs/labels would contaminate validation.
_sequence_rows(seq) has no explicit cutoff in training; relies on index_history rejecting future observations. Prefix summaries exclude each own outcome.
Every nonempty stream must have min_side on each side; one short stream can veto all boundaries. Detector measures rate changes, not interaction signs.
Constructor does not validate positive total expert weight; all zero weights produces division by zero. Keep valid frozen settings.
entry-main stale episode-memory docstring contradicts actual E6 code. Final catches every E7 exception and silently changes forecast to E6 after stderr warning.
